items.name: Åkervindel
items.observations: Original clearly illustrated botanical field-bindweed watercolor with slender prostrate and twining stems, alternate arrow-shaped leaves, small white and pale-pink funnel flowers with radial pink stripes, narrow bracteoles set below flowers, twisted buds and green capsules. Inspected on a solid black background; composition and morphology compared with RHS, Cornell and Kew descriptions.
items.limitations: Stylized original educational illustration, not a photograph or botanical voucher and not a standalone identification key. The deep branching roots and precise bract placement are simplified. A few leaves and flower sizes are enlarged for readability.
